title: core-js: negative start indexes that reach before the array start are off by one
prompt: This is a copy of the core-js 3.50.0 package (the polyfill modules, their shared internal helpers and the entry points; plain CommonJS). There is a regression in the polyfill internals: whenever a relative index goes further back than the start of the array, it no longer clamps to the first element but to the second. For example the polyfilled Array indexOf/includes with a fromIndex of -10 on a 3-element array skip the first element, and the same off-by-one shows up in the other methods that accept negative start/end positions (fill, copyWithin, slice, splice, subarray). Find the shared cause and fix it at its source, not in each method.
